Encryption, TLS, and AES protect data in transit, at rest, and through key management, respectively. [1]

claims.text: Encryption, TLS, and AES protect data in transit, at rest, and through key management, respectively.
quotes: Encryption transforms readable information into ciphertext using cryptographic keys. TLS protects data in transit. AES protects data at rest. Authorized recipients need the correct keys to recover plaintext. Key management and rotation are essential controls.

claims.text: Firewalls, multifactor authentication, least-privilege permissions, and monitoring are network security controls.
quotes: Network security defends systems against intruders and malicious traffic. Firewalls filter connections, multifactor authentication reduces stolen-password risk, and least-privilege permissions restrict access. Regular patching closes known vulnerabilities. Monitoring can detect suspicious activity.
